breadth.criterion: every mandatory atlas cell created by this wave has explicit owner and verifier skills, and the final primary-source sweep exposes no unowned material surface, modality, AI role, risk class, temporal class, social context, or specialist decision class
breadth.observed: The core atlas plus four adversarial extensions cover the general, emerging, accessibility, safety-critical and specialist boundaries discovered in the wave. The graph contains 125 declared skills, and extension-specific atlas validators require owner and verifier nodes rather than prose-only coverage.

depth.criterion: high-risk and high-drift domains are grounded in current primary authority and represented by distinct decision/evidence/output contracts rather than shallow topic labels
depth.observed: The wave reviewed current W3C, ISO/IEC, IEC, FAA, platform and regulator sources across accessibility, AI, human factors, safety, haptics, XR, automotive, flight deck, robotics, BCI, control rooms, affective UI, avatars, AAC, accessible media and cross-device actions. New skills are depth-gated and require Decision Model, Evidence, Output Contract and Failure Traps.

contradictions.criterion: source status and authority conflicts are preserved or resolved by scope instead of flattened into one rule
contradictions.observed: WCAG 2.2 remains the current normative web conformance baseline used by this wave while WCAG 3 is explicitly draft; ISO/FDIS/CD/AWI documents remain drafts; published standards remain separate; platform visual trends remain contextual; sign language is separated from AAC symbols/captions; certification guidance does not become a generic UI compliance claim.

novelty.criterion: after successive adversarial sweeps, the final primary-source decomposition sweep adds zero material non-decomposable owner classes
novelty.observed: Successive sweeps added 4, then 3, then 4, then 2 genuinely new owners. The final sweep added zero: recent standards on information presentation, HCD self-assessment, NUI evaluation, intelligent systems, voice mobility, haptics, immersive media, rehabilitation robotics and multimodal customer service all decomposed into existing faculties. Evidence is recorded in knowledge/final-saturation-evidence.json.

freshness.criterion: high-drift sources are reviewed against the current date, draft status is explicit, and the system carries conditions that force future research waves to reopen
freshness.observed: Sources were reviewed on 2026-08-12, including 2025-2026 standards and platform guidance. Drafts are tagged by lifecycle stage, current platform/AI sources are treated as high drift, and reopen conditions cover standards, regulation, platforms, modalities, AI behavior, evidence invalidation and atlas ownership loss.

reopen_conditions: new platform surface or interaction environment
new material specialist UI decision class that cannot decompose into existing owners
material AI or generative-UI behavior or platform change
new empirical evidence invalidates an existing mechanism
mandatory atlas cell becomes unowned or unverifiable
a high-drift source exceeds its research-radar freshness window
